title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
author: Mohammed Nayeem Khan, Logesh L, Aliyas Ahmad Misri
description: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin). summary: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin).
takeaways: Quantization is simulated, the model is Qwen3-0.6B, and the benchmark is GSM8K.
A live random control, a thinking-mode phase rule, a second model and live KL were not run.

We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin).
